entities.name: Sarpadian Empires
entities.description: Seven-volume tome documenting the fall of Sarpadia's five dominant kingdoms; found during the Time Spiral crisis it gained magical properties able to summon creatures from the past.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Continent on Dominaria whose kingdoms fell.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Order whose thrull creations caused their downfall.

entities.name: Havenwood elves
entities.description: Elves whose thallid creations caused their downfall.

entities.name: Homarids
entities.description: Migrating species who drove out the merfolk.

entities.name: Time Spiral crisis
entities.description: Crisis during which the tome gained magical properties.

events.summary: Icatia, the final kingdom, fell, ending Sarpadia's story.
events.quote: Vol. VI told the final chapter of Sarpadia as the final kingdom, Icatia , fell.

events.summary: Merfolk were driven from their lands by the homarids' migration.
events.quote: Vol. V describes the plight of the merfolk as they are driven out of their lands by the homarids ' migration to warmer climes.
